name: Gmail
label: Gmail — Google Gmail API v1
description: Gmail via the official Google Gmail API v1. Base https://gmail.googleapis.com/gmail/v1. Docs: https://developers.google.com/gmail/api/reference/rest. Restricted Gmail scopes need Google CASA/verification. Never log message bodies. Receives users.watch notifications via Cloud Pub/Sub HTTP push. Cross-ref none. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Attachments belong inside raw (URL-safe base64 RFC 2822); this node does not send a separate file. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification config (webhook_secret, webhook_header_name) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Gmail operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"send-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-message | reply-message | get-message | list-messages | delete-message | mark-read | mark-unread | add-label-message | remove-label-message | create-draft | get-draft | list-drafts | delete-draft | create-label | get-label | list-labels | delete-label | get-thread | list-threads | reply-thread | trash-thread | untrash-thread | delete-thread | add-label-thread | remove-label-thread | listen. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: first verb.

schema.label: To
schema.description: Recipients for send-message, reply-message, reply-thread and create-draft. Comma-separated addresses. Example: ada@example.com, Bob <bob@example.com>. Required unless raw is set.

schema.label: From
schema.description: Sender address. Must be the account or a verified send-as alias; Gmail uses the account address when empty. Example: Ada <ada@example.com>.

schema.label: Cc
schema.description: Cc recipients, comma-separated. Omit when unused.

schema.label: Bcc
schema.description: Bcc recipients, comma-separated. Omit when unused.

schema.label: Reply-To
schema.description: Reply-To address(es), comma-separated. Omit when unused.

schema.label: Subject
schema.description: Message subject. For replies keep the original subject (optionally prefixed with Re:) so Gmail threads it.

schema.label: Text body
schema.description: Plain-text body. When html is also set the message is multipart/alternative.

schema.label: HTML body
schema.description: HTML body. Omit for plain-text mail.

schema.label: In-Reply-To
schema.description: Message-ID header of the message being answered (reply-message / reply-thread), e.g. <CAF...@mail.gmail.com>. Use with threadId so the reply stays in the thread.

schema.label: References
schema.description: References header for replies: the Message-IDs of the thread, space-separated. Defaults to in_reply_to when empty.

schema.label: Attachments
schema.description: Files to attach: list of StudioQuack file blocks {mime_type, source, data, name}. Up to 25.

schema.label: raw
schema.description: Prebuilt RFC 2822 message as Gmail raw (URL-safe base64). Optional: when empty the node builds it from to/from/cc/bcc/reply_to/subject/text/html/in_reply_to/references/attachments. Sent as-is when set.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Gmail message, draft, label, or thread id for get/delete/modify. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: threadId
schema.description: Thread id for reply-message / reply-thread / create-draft. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Gmail search query for list-messages, list-threads, and list-drafts. Example: from:ada@example.com is:unread. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: labelIds
schema.description: Label id filter for list-messages and list-threads. Sent as one query value. Modify operations use addLabelIds and removeLabelIds, not this field. Example: INBOX. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Label name for create-label. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: format
schema.description: Gmail format: full | metadata | minimal | raw. Default full. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: addLabelIds
schema.description: Label ids to add. JSON array of strings. mark-unread uses ["UNREAD"]. add-label-message and add-label-thread use this list. Example: ["UNREAD"]. Omit when unused.

schema.label: removeLabelIds
schema.description: Label ids to remove. JSON array of strings. mark-read uses ["UNREAD"]. remove-label-message and remove-label-thread use this list. Example: ["UNREAD"]. Omit when unused.

schema.label: maxResults
schema.description: Page size for list-messages, list-threads, and list-drafts. Positive integer. Gmail caps messages and threads at 500. Example: 20. Omit when unused.

schema.label: pageToken
schema.description: nextPageToken from a previous list-messages, list-threads, or list-drafts response. Example: 0123456789. Omit when unused.

schema.label: labelListVisibility
schema.description: create-label only. EXACT: labelShow | labelShowIfUnread | labelHide. Example: labelShow. Omit when unused.

schema.label: messageListVisibility
schema.description: create-label only. EXACT: show | hide. Example: show. Omit when unused.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-message, reply-message, get-message, list-messages, delete-message, mark-read, mark-unread, add-label-message, remove-label-message, create-draft, get-draft, list-drafts, delete-draft, create-label, get-label, list-labels, delete-label, get-thread, list-threads, reply-thread, trash-thread, untrash-thread, delete-thread, add-label-thread, remove-label-thread, listen. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (webhook_secret, webhook_header_name), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event.

configurationParameters.label: OAuth access token
configurationParameters.description: Google OAuth 2.0 access token with Gmail scopes (gmail.send / gmail.modify / gmail.readonly as needed). Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT. Refresh stays in the secret store. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: user_id
configurationParameters.description: Gmail userId. Default me. Accepted: me or the mailbox email.

configurationParameters.label: Default sender
configurationParameters.description: Sender address used when INPUT from is empty. Must be the account or a verified send-as alias. Example: Ada <ada@example.com>.

configurationParameters.label: raw
configurationParameters.description: Optional RFC 2822 message as Gmail raw (URL-safe base64), including any attachments. Sent only when INPUT raw is empty, on send-message, reply-message, reply-thread, and create-draft. INPUT raw wins when it is set. A call that omits operation uses the default operation and will send this value. Never log. Example: a base64url MIME blob.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Auth Header Name
